---
name: Bug Report
about: Create a report to help us improve ScrubIN
title: "[BUG]: "
labels: ["bug"]
assignees: ''
---

### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is (e.g. false positive detection, missed entity, unhandled crash).

### To Reproduce
Command or code executed:
```bash
scrubin scrub "sample input text"
```

### Expected Behavior
A clear description of what you expected to happen.

### Actual Output
What was actually scrubbed or the error traceback.

### Environment
- OS: [e.g. Ubuntu 22.04, Windows 11, macOS]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.10, 3.11]
- Engine used: [rules / ollama / gliner]
